scope: Normal source merchant Courier refill and sale contracts; independent source implementation, not an installed-game trace.
contracts: Colored card entries retain readonly CardType, roll rarity without changing player future odds, and exclude all currently stocked card models including their own pre-purchase CreationResult.
Colorless card entries retain their fixed readonly rarity without fallback or a rarity roll.
Every card refill consumes one Shops model-selection draw, one Shops price draw and one Rewards upgrade roll; colored entries additionally consume one Rewards rarity roll.
Courier refill clears IsOnSale and does not roll a new sale index or recalculate its price twice.
Potion refill passes an empty blacklist, allowing duplicates of remaining stocked potions.
Relic refill rolls one Rewards rarity, pulls from the back of its shared bag excluding stocked models, then consumes one Shops price draw.
Initial card sale stores the recalculated price divided by two with integer truncation before merchant price modifiers.
